title: Extract action items
summary: List the action items in notes, with owner and due date if stated.

inputs.text:
Notes from Tuesday.
Priya will send the revised budget to finance by Friday 14 June.
We agreed to move the launch to 2 July.
Someone should look at the vendor contract at some point.
Tom: I'll book the room.
Maybe we could try a new logo.
The report must be filed by 30 June.
We discussed the weather and the football.

sections.use: Turn meeting notes, emails or transcripts into a list of action items with their owner and due date when the text states them.
sections.exclusions: Suggestions and ideas are not listed. Dates are not interpreted or converted.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 32,768 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 6,144 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Input up to 40,000 characters; at most 50 items.
sections.missing_data: owner and due are null unless stated; text without actions gives an empty list.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.

inputs.text: The notes or text to read.

outputs.items: Action items: task, owner (or null) and due (or null), as written.
